description: This file contains assembly code embedded within Perl scripts for cryptographic operations, specifically implementing a constant-time GHASH function optimized with SSSE3 instructions for x86 architecture. It includes functions for multiplication and hashing in GCM mode, with detailed comments on the algorithm and bit manipulations.

methods.name: process_rows
methods.description: Emits assembly code to process a specified number of rows of the H table, performing bit shifts, table lookups, and reduction operations for GHASH multiplication.

methods.name: gcm_gmult_ssse3
methods.description: Performs multiplication of the Xi value by the H table using SSSE3 instructions, deserializing input, processing multiple rows, and serializing the result.

methods.name: gcm_ghash_ssse3
methods.description: Incorporates input data into the GHASH value Xi using the H table, processing data in blocks, and handling byte order reversal.
